Wonderful Bar. Best pool in town!
May 2019 • Friends
The Kneipe is a fairly new bar in the area, but thankfully, I'm fairly new here as well. The owner Nga, from Hanoi, is very welcoming and friendly and all the drinks + food are reasonably priced and of the quality anyone would be happy with. Their kitchen is top of the line so no fears of eating something dodgy here. 
On top of all this, they have the best pool table I have found in the city so if thats how you like to spend your time, you will definitely not be disappointed. 

Excellent addition to the area as far as I can tell.
